BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to transportation safety improvement funding;adding a new section to chapter 48.14 RCW; and providing an effectivedate.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.14 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Each insurer engaged in writing automobile policies shall, onor before April 15th of each year, pay to the state treasurer throughthe commissioner's office a transportation enforcement fee. The feeshall be one dollar per vehicle and must be included in the premiumsfor all motor vehicle insurance policies. Twothirds of the moneyshall be deposited into the state patrol highway account created in RCW46.68.030 to be used for additional emphasis patrols inhigh-accident-corridor locations on state routes; and the remaindershall be deposited into the highway safety fund created in RCW46.68.060 to be used to create a county road highaccident-corridoremphasis patrol program. The program shall be administered by theWashington state traffic safety commission. County law enforcement mayapply to the commission for emphasis patrols on specific p. 1 SB 6726high-accident-corridors within their county. The commission shalldetermine what criteria to use in awarding these emphasis patrols. Theemphasis patrols shall be performed by the Washington state patrol atno cost to the county. For purposes of this section,high-accident-corridor means a highway corridor of one mile or morewhere a fiveyear analysis of collision history indicates that thesection has higher than average collision and severity factors. (2) The commissioner shall annually, on or before April 1st,calculate and bill each organization for the amount of the fee. Feesshall be due and payable no later than April 15th of each year. Thepenalties for failure to pay fees when due shall be the same as thepenalties for failure to pay taxes pursuant to RCW 48.14.060. The feesrequired by this section are in addition to all other taxes and feesnow imposed or that may be subsequently imposed.
